notes: Year-only file: page Styles 1, 4, and 5 state their year rules in text and are shipped; their month-letter mappings (Styles 1 and 4) live only in chart images, so no month is encoded rather than guessed. Page Styles 2 (April-May 1980 only) and 3 (1962 into early 1980) are HELD, NOT SHIPPED: both encode year and month as letters whose mappings are chart-image-only, so no table can be transcribed from text. Held styles are image-pass items (see report). Parent value is the page's stated parent line verbatim. Style ids keep the page's style numbers so held styles map unambiguously.

styles.era: Current style since June 1980 (page Style 1, year-only)
styles.notes: Page example shown as '000F 950926066-1'; normalized it is 000F9509260661. Page positions 5-6 (1-based) = year digits, converted to 0-based half-open [4,6]. Page position 4 (letter) = month, but the letter-to-month mapping is chart-image-only (BARD-Date-of-Manufacture-Serial-Number-Style-1.jpg), so month is null here. Expected year 1995 is derived from the year digits under the century rule, not page-stated.

styles.era: Year as last 2 digits (page Style 4, year-only)
styles.notes: Page example shown as '36284 M 83'; normalized it is 36284M83. Page rule: year = last 2 digits, converted to [6,8] for this 8-character example shape. The letter preceding the last 2 digits = month, but its mapping is chart-image-only (BARD-Date-of-Manufacture-Serial-Number-Style-4.jpg), so month is null here. Expected year 1983 is derived from the year digits under the century rule, not page-stated.

styles.era: 9-digit numeric, year in first 2 digits (page Style 5, year-only)
styles.notes: Page example '940128116'. Page positions 1-2 (1-based) = year digits, converted to [0,2]. The page states no month rule for this style. Expected year 1994 is derived from the year digits under the century rule, not page-stated.
